name: Qwen-VL: A Versatile Vision-Language Model for Understanding, Localization, and Text Recognition
problem: Generalist VLMs of comparable scale lacked grounded text reading and localisation ability.
mechanism: Qwen-LM foundation plus a designed visual receptor, an input-output interface, a 3-stage training pipeline and a multilingual multimodal cleaned corpus. Grounding is trained by aligning image-caption-BOX tuples rather than free-form captions alone.
notes:
Technical report, no peer-reviewed venue found. The Qwen-VL family is one of the most widely deployed open VLMs, and the Qwen2.5-VL line that followed made dynamic-resolution native - images are resized to fit a token budget, which is a serving-visible behaviour: cost tracks the configured resolution, not the source image. The Qwen2-VL successor introduced window attention for large images to keep the vision encoder's own attention cost sub-quadratic; the original Qwen-VL here does not have it.
